info.title: Tool.Format
info.description: Line-based C# comment reflow and indentation tool: a faithful port of the briefcases Python formatting scripts, validated by a golden oracle. - 0.9.3.2624 net10.0

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: epsitec-format — line-based C# comment reflow and indentation tool.

options.name: --fix
options.description: Apply fixable rules in place. Absent means check mode (no writes). [default: False]

options.name: --rules
options.description: Comma-separated subset of comments,indent,initializers. Absent means all three.

options.name: --max-columns
options.description: Positive integer wrap width. Defaults to 79. [default: 79]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the structured JSON report on stdout. Absent means a human-readable summary. [default: False]

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description: Files, directories, or glob patterns to scan. Defaults to the current directory.
